source_quotes.text: This circular provides guidance to management companies of funds that are authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong (Funds)6 in this regard.

A Fund will be considered as a complex product if its total direct and indirect exposures to private market assets amount to 50% or more of the Fund’s NAV. On a case-by-case basis, the SFC may also designate a Fund as a complex product, taking into account factors including, without limitation:
In assessing whether the complex product designation is warranted7, the SFC will adopt a holistic approach taking into account the specific circumstances of the case.
In cases where the Fund’s aggregate direct and indirect exposures to private market assets are less than 50% of the Fund’s NAV.
Except for listed closed-ended alternative asset funds (LAFs).
The examples of indirect exposures set out in paragraph 1 above are non-exhaustive, and subject to review and update by the SFC from time to time in view of market developments.

A Fund classified as a complex product will be subject to the SFC’s prevailing requirements for the sale of complex products8 including but not limited to ensuring the suitability of the Fund for its investors irrespective of whether solicitation or recommendation is involved.

assumptions: The circular applies at the specified assessment time; its commencement is not established by this packet.
The selected control evaluates only the two stated classification routes, not exhaustive legal status or compliance with distribution duties.
The threshold fact requires supported exposure measurement; disclosed investment maxima, instrument labels and rounded percentages cannot substitute for that evidence.
An operative designation requires evidence of an actual SFC decision, not merely a risk factor or prospective assessment.
Unknown facts remain unknown. An out-of-scope Fund receives no classification result from this control.
The expression does not resolve persistence of classification arising from an earlier threshold crossing.
hypotheses.controlled_language: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Selected control: whether either stated classification route is satisfied for an in-scope Fund at the assessment time. True means combined direct and indirect private-market exposure is at least 50% of NAV, including exactly 50%, or an operative SFC case-by-case designation exists; the Fund must consequently be treated as complex under this reading. False means both specified routes are affirmatively absent at that time. It does not establish non-complex status, cessation of historical classification, compliance with sale requirements or an exemption under another instrument. Missing evidence does not supply a false fact.
opposing_reasons: Does a prior threshold-based classification persist after exposure falls below 50%, independently of an operative discretionary designation?
What exposure methodology and operative designation evidence permit evaluation at the selected time?
What separate treatment applies to LAFs under the absent referenced circular?
